purpose: Read-only city-specific source discovery and bounded access review; no runtime or global changes.
assessment: The official Uzbekistan Cadastre Agency lists a Namangan city cadastre office and city cadastral divisions; current agency reporting also documents cadastral inventory work in Namangan Region. This establishes city-local cadastral administration, but not public city parcel-vector access. National geoportal and State Urban Cadastre are candidates, not yet verified as city-feature sources. The local cadastral office is confirmed, but the national public geoportal presents a terms-consent step and no documented geometry/property allowlist was found. The city-scoped vector layer and privacy-safe feature contract remain unverified; no parcel query was made.

officialEvidence.observation: Official Uzbekistan Cadastre Agency listing includes Namangan city among the regional cadastral offices/divisions. The site timed out during direct retrieval; indexed first-party result was used, and no outage conclusion is made.
Cadastre Agency news (2026-07-29) reports ongoing technical inventory of real-estate objects in Namangan Region; province-wide counts are not treated as city coverage.

National Cadastre Agency Geoportal shell advertises cadastral-number search and displays a public-offer consent dialog. No consent, search or feature request was submitted; no safe property schema was verified.
State Urban Cadastre portal describes general public and restricted user data and urban-planning layers; its public data scope is not shown to include Namangan cadastral parcels.
Official city administration page identifies Namangan City Administration and its office, confirming city context but not parcel data.

routes: Public portal shell includes cadastral-number search; a terms-of-use consent dialog appears. No search or layer query was made.
viewer.notes: The portal is national rather than a Namangan city service, and no city-specific feature schema or safe attributes were verified. The State Urban Cadastre portal separately advertises public data and restricted registered-user content; no cadastral parcel layer was established.
